metadata.description: Dominik Woźniak's software delivery process for Claude Code: a plugin marketplace and the code behind it.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Dominik Woźniak's software delivery process in one plugin: deterministic guards that refuse destructive git, the env files the repository does not vouch for, the wrong package manager, sloppy commits and writes to App Store Connect; the Sync that brings a repository's References to their ref as a session starts; and the skills /sdlc-setup, /sdlc-doctor, /sdlc-references-add, /sdlc-pr-open, which opens a pull request and writes its body, /sdlc-pr-ship, which drives a pull request to merged, and /sdlc-sweep, which removes what has landed. A repository's own rules come from its .ai/agentic.config.json.

plugins.name: sdlc-sessions
plugins.description: The skills that run a Claude Code session: /sdlc-recap answers where a session stands, in one fixed shape, with whether it can be closed; /sdlc-brief turns an issue, a spec or an idea into a Brief, the start of a Worker session; /sdlc-delegate makes the session a Lead that hands Briefs to Workers in herdr and relays their Recaps. It depends on sdlc, so a session keeps its guards.
